messages:
anna: Sharing the postmortem link and a quick sync — last night's rollout caused a regional spike and several customers saw tail latency increases. Need owners for follow-ups: auto-rollback tuning, feature-flag scoping/blast radius, and canary sampling. Short replies only pls.

raj: I can own auto-rollback tuning. ETA EOW unless we need infra changes. Which metrics should trigger rollback?

maria: I'll take flag scoping + blast radius controls. Will open a ticket and propose a default policy for internal vs private customers.

kevin: I'll handle canary sampling & traffic shaping. Quick thought — should we shorten the auto-rollback decision window to avoid long exposure?

incident-bot: incident-bot: Postmortem uploaded: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-22-rollout-latency-spike

anna: Thanks. Action list for tracking:
- raj: auto-rollback policy + unit/integration tests (bring thresholds + metric set)
- maria: flag scoping + default blast-radius policy for public vs private customers
- kevin: sampling orchestration + dashboards/alerts for canaries
I'll own the tracking doc and kickoff calendar invites. Add PRs/issues to this thread. :clipboard:

raj: Quick question — do we also permanently slow down the rollout speed? Current pipeline does 5%->25% in 10m.

maria: I prefer a slower profile: 5% -> 15% over 30m, hold 15m, then 15% -> 50% over 60m. That reduces blast radius and gives time for metrics to surface.

kevin: I'll update the rollout config. Proposed snippet for the rollout policy (staging first):

```
rollout: {
  phases: [
    { pct: 5, duration_sec: 600 },
    { pct: 15, duration_sec: 1800, hold_sec: 900 },
    { pct: 50, duration_sec: 3600 }
  ],
  autoRollback: { enabled: true, window_sec: 120, error_rate_threshold: 0.05 }
}
```

raj: That looks reasonable. For rollback metrics let's use: 95th_latency, error_rate, and rerank-quality-regression. I'll put exact thresholds in the RFC.

raj: Creating issue RFC-3421 for auto-rollback tuning: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RFC-3421 (assigning to myself).

maria: Created ENG-2987 for flag scoping: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-2987 — assigning to @maria, due EOD Fri for initial proposal.

kevin: I'll wire up dashboards: grafana/dashboards/rollouts and add alert rules for the three metrics above.

anna: :thumbsup: Let's schedule a 30m sync Tue 10:00 to review progress and blockers. I'll send calendar invite.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary config changed in staging by @kevin. Details: PR #612

kevin: PR #612: https://git.redwood.net/redwood/rollout-configs/pull/612 — will request reviews from @raj and @maria shortly.

raj: Reviewing today. If I need infra changes I'll flag it in RFC-3421.

maria: Reviewing the PR as well. Will comment on blast-radius defaults for private customers.

anna: One more note: for private deployments we should default max blast radius to 10% and require a manual approval to exceed. Add into private deploy playbook.

kevin: Noted — I'll add a guardrail check in the rollout validator and include a unit test.

anna: Thanks team. I'll update the postmortem with owners, ticket links, and timelines. For any new blockers, reopen this thread. Closing for new items.
